text: Liverpool tried to sign France right-back Malo Gusto, 23, on deadline day but the loan move did not materialise as Chelsea wanted a permanent transfer. ( Fabrice Hawkins )

Chelsea made a late attempt to sign Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott, 23, to replace Enzo Fernandez but the Cherries had no interest in selling the former England Under-21 player this summer. ( Mirror )
Arsenal rejected an enquiry from Chelsea for 27-year-old Spain midfielder Martin Zubimendi. (Sun)

Manchester United are planning to make three defensive signings next summer with some of their key defenders like England duo Luke Shaw, 31, and Harry Maguire, 33, Argentina's Lisandro Martinez, 28, and Netherlands international Matthijs de Ligt, 27, "on trial" this season. ( Sun )

Manchester United striker Chido Obi, 18, is keen for a loan move to the Netherlands or his native Denmark - both countries where the transfer window only closes on Wednesday - with Feyenoord among interested clubs. ( Mirror )
Everton were interested in signing Monaco full-back Jordan Teze, 26, but the Ligue 1 club's management vetoed the Netherlands international's exit. ( Nice-Matin - in French )
England defender Fikayo Tomori, 28, will be reinstated into manager Ruben Amorim's squad at AC Milan after he resisted a move away from the Serie A side. ( Di Marzio - in Italian )
Liverpool forward Cody Gakpo, 27, held "clear the air" talks with the Reds' hierarchy after they refused to sanction a sale to Manchester City ( ED - in Dutch )
Wrexham are interested in signing free agent Jamie Vardy, 39, but face competition for the ex-England striker from Brazilian club Sao Paulo and League One side Sheffield Wednesday . ( TalkSport )
Al-Ittihad have joined fellow Saudi Pro League side Diriyah in exploring a move for Aston Villa and Jamaica winger Leon Bailey, 29. ( Athletic - subscription required )

Arsenal are still interested in signing Atletico Madrid and Argentina forward Julian Alvarez and are actively working to make a potential move to London easier for the 26-year-old and his entourage. (Teamtalk)
Liverpool have rejected a £30m bid from Nottingham Forest for England Under-20 midfielder Trey Nyoni, 19. (Athletic - subscription required)

Borussia Dortmund are considering giving free agent Jadon Sancho a career lifeline but the 26-year-old English winger would have to accept a heavily performance-based contract and also have to forgo a signing bonus with the German club. (Bild - in German)
Ajax have enquired about 24-year-old Sunderland and Ivory Coast winger Simon Adingra. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Fulham have opened talks with Eintracht Frankfurt to sign 22-year-old Sweden midfielder Hugo Larsson. (Fabrizio Romano)
Newcastle and Juventus have reached a verbal agreement over a loan move, with no buy option, for 24-year-old Germany forward Nick Woltemade. (Florian Plettenberg)
Tottenham have enquired to AC Milan about signing 27-year-old United States winger Christian Pulisic. (Teamtalk)
Liverpool and Everton are interested in Stuttgart winger Jamie Leweling, 25, with Roma also pushing to sign the German. (Patrick Berger / Sky Sport Germany)
Newcastle are exploring a deal to sign Lille forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo, 21, but nothing is advanced in terms of negotiations for the Belgium international. (Florian Plettenberg)
Everton are working on a second loan deal for Man City and England winger Jack Grealish. (Athletic)
Crystal Palace are determined to keep England goalkeeper Dean Henderson, 29, after a bid from Nottingham Forest. (Mail - subscription required)
Newcastle United, Aston Villa and Chelsea are all interested in signing 20-year-old Cameroon striker Christian Kofane from Bayer Leverkusen. (Football Insider)
Liverpool are monitoring Genk goalkeeper Lucca Brughmans, 18, but if a deal happens this summer it will not result in an immediate move for the Belgium youth international. (Ben Jacobs)
Crystal Palace and Fulham are in talks over a move for Eintracht Frankfurt midfielder Hugo Larsson, 22, with a fee of around £25m potentially enough to secure the Swede. (Teamtalk)
Crystal Palace have revived talks with Marseille for 25-year-old Netherlands midfielder Quinten Timber. (Mail - subscription required)

Juventus are still considering signing Manchester United striker Joshua Zirkzee, 25, but a move for the Netherlands forward will depend on whether Jonathan David leaves the Serie A side for Atletico Madrid. (Sky Sport Italy)
Multiple Italian clubs have shown interest in Newcastle striker Nick Woltemade, 24, with Napoli showing the most serious interest in taking the German on loan. (Sky Sports)
Sunderland want to sign Manchester City winger Jack Grealish on loan and are confident of securing the 30-year-old Englishman. (Football Insider)
Arsenal are exploring a move for Lille forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo, 21, with the Belgium international valued at £60m. (Caught Offside)
Crystal Palace winger Ismaila Sarr, 28, is keen on a move to Liverpool as talks continue between the clubs over a deal for the Senegal attacker. (Sun)
Sunderland are looking at signing Levante striker Karl Etta Eyong, 22, with a £26m release clause in place for the Cameroon forward. (Sun)
Fiorentina have enquired to Leeds United about signing their 22-year-old Italy winger Wilfried Gnonto. (Athletic - subscription required)
Sunderland are close to agreeing a fee for Marseille winger Igor Paixao, 26, but the French club are continuing to fight to keep the Brazilian. (Teamtalk)
Aston Villa have made Manchester United an offer for Ivory Coast attacker Amad Diallo, 24. (225 Foot - in French)
Hull City manager Sergej Jakirovic has urged the club not to send 26-year-old English left-back Ryan Giles on loan to Burnley after an agreement was reached. (Talksport)
AC Milan have reached an agreement with Nottingham Forest to sign 22-year-old English winger Omari Hutchinson (Sky Sports).
Manchester United have not ruled out England forward Marcus Rashford leaving the club, with Arsenal and Barcelona monitoring the 28-year-old's situation. (Teamtalk)
Monaco and Senegal midfielder Lamine Camara, 22, is under consideration as a possible replacement for Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez. (Mail)
Newcastle are making a late push to sign Belgium forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo, 21, from Lille. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Argentina and Atletico Madrid forward Julian Alvarez, 26, has rejected the chance to return to Manchester City . (Cadena Ser - in Spanish)
Newcastle are also interested in Stuttgart's Bilal El Khannouss, 22, although they may face competition from Everton for the Morocco midfielder. (Sky Germany)
The Magpies are also attempting to sell Germany striker Nick Woltemade, 24, before the end of the transfer window. (Talksport)
Arsenal have renewed their interest in Real Madrid and Brazil forward Endrick, 20, who is concerned about where he sits in the pecking order at the Bernabeu. (Teamtalk)

Manchester United , Tottenham and Galatasaray might move for Crystal Palace striker Jean‑Philippe Mateta, 29, but Aston Villa have shown the strongest interest after a £20m bid for the Frenchman. (Caught Offside)
Sweden midfielder Hugo Larsson, 22, is on the verge of leaving Eintracht Frankfurt with Crystal Palace being one of two Premier League clubs trying to secure his signature. (Sky Germany)
Burnley are looking to sign Hull City left-back Ryan Giles on loan, with an option to make the 26-year-old Englishman's arrival permanent next summer. (Football Insider)
Valencia are in advanced talks to sign English midfielder Harvey Elliott, 23, on loan from Liverpool . (Matteo Moretto)
Aston Villa have agreed a £47m deal to sign 18-year-old Paris St-Germain and Senegal winger Ibrahim Mbaye. (Mail)
Arsenal are refusing to give up on their pursuit of Argentina forward Julian Alvarez, 26, who is keen to move away from Atletico Madrid . (Mail)
Manchester City have identified attacking midfielder Iliman Ndiaye, 26, as a potential target but Everton club value the Senegal international at around £80m. (Guardian)
Aston Villa have made direct contact with AC Milan and Portugal winger Rafael Leao, 27, as they try to beat Galatasaray in the race to sign him. (Fabrizio Romano)
Nottingham Forest have made an offer worth up to £22m for Crystal Palace and Colombia wing-back Daniel Munoz, 30. ( Athletic - subscription required )
Atletico Madrid are considering signing Brazil forwards Igor Jesus, 25, and Gabriel Jesus, 29, from Nottingham Forest and Arsenal . (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Napoli are considering a loan move for Newcastle and Germany striker Nick Woltemade, 24. ( Fabrizio Romano - in Italian )
Manchester United have been offered the chance to sign Chelsea 's English centre-back Tosin Adarabioyo, 28, as Michael Carrick's side look to strengthen their defence. ( GiveMeSport )
Hull City are close to an agreement with AS Roma to sign French striker Robinio Vaz, 19. ( Athletic - subscription required )
Chelsea are in talks to sell Spanish striker Marc Guiu, 20, to Napoli and the deal is progressing. ( Sky Sports )
Chelsea and Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez, 25, remains hopeful of completing a move to Manchester City . ( Fabrizio Romano )
Fiorentina and Italy forward Moise Kean is increasingly close to joining Como in a deal that could reach around £35m. (Sky Sports Italy - in Italian)
Leeds have granted Brazilian goalkeeper Lucas Perri, 28, permission to finalise his move to Torino on loan with an option to buy. (Sky Sports)
Leeds , meanwhile, are considering a move for Standard Liege and DR Congo goalkeeper Matthieu Epolo, 21. ( Get French Football News)
Chelsea have lined up Bournemouth 's English midfielder Alex Scott, 23, as a replacement for Argentina's Enzo Fernandez, 25, who might be on the move to Manchester City . (Sun)
Aston Villa target Rafael Leao is close to agreeing a move from AC Milan, with Galatasaray set to pay about £38m for the 27-year-old Portugal winger. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Sunderland have made Manchester City an offer to sign England winger Jack Grealish, 30, on loan. (Athletic - subscription required)
Chelsea are also closing in on a £36m deal to sign Italy defender Honest Ahanor, 18, from Atalanta . ( Sky Sport Italy - in Italian )
Barcelona and Spain defender Alejandro Balde, 22, remains on Manchester United 's shortlist to reinforce their left-back position. (Fichajes - in Spanish)

Newcastle have not yet walked away from a deal to sign Lille and Belgium winger Matias Fernandez-Pardo, 21, but will not do anything that causes problems in meeting Premier League and Uefa spending rules. (Mail - subscription required)
Bayer Leverkusen's French striker Martin Terrier, 29, is being lined up by his former club Lille as a replacement for Fernandez-Pardo. (L'Equipe - in French)
Fiorentina have turned down Nottingham Forest 's initial bid of £6m for their Brazilian right-back Dodo, 27. ( Sky Sport Italy - in Italian )
Marseille are confident of keeping Brazilian forward Igor Paixao, 26, despite interest from Arsenal and Sunderland . (Teamtalk)
Aston Villa have asked about West Ham and France defender Jean-Clair Todibo, 26, as they search for a centre-back. (Mail)
Bayer Leverkusen and Argentina midfielder Exequiel Palacios, 27, is close to completing a £23.5m move to Ipswich Town . (Sky Sports)
Everton are lining up a deal to sign Guinea-Bissau forward Franculino, 22, from Midtjylland and are also prepared to sanction the sale of Republic of Ireland defender Jake O'Brien, 25. (Teamtalk)
Aston Villa have made an offer for Crystal Palace and France striker Jean-Philippe Mateta, 29, although it falls well below the London club's valuation. (Athletic - subscription required)
Villa are also on the verge of agreeing a 70m euros (£59.8m) deal to sign Chelsea and Senegal striker Nicolas Jackson, 25. (Foot Mercato - in French)
Manchester United are considering making contact with Stuttgart over a potential move for 20-year-old German defender Finn Jeltsch. (CaughtOffside)
Manchester City will submit a formal offer to Chelsea for Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez, 25, before the end of the transfer window. (Fabrizio Romano)
Tottenham could hijack Napoli's pursuit of Marseille and Algeria winger Amine Gouiri, 26. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Newcastle will submit a final offer worth 60m euros (£51m) for Lille and Belgium forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo, 21. (Sacha Tavolieri)
Leeds United and Crystal Palace have registered an interest in Everton and Ireland defender Jake O'Brien, 25. (Football insider)
Nottingham Forest are in talks with Corinthians over a move for 20-year-old Brazil midfielder Andre. (Daily Mail - subscription only)
Hull City have agreed a deal with Union Berlin to sign 21-year-old Ilyas Ansah. The deal for the German forward will total more than 20m (£17.1m). (Fabrizio Romano)
Manchester City have entered the race to sign Liverpool and Netherlands forward Cody Gakpo, 27, with Tottenham also still working on a deal. (Soccer News NL - in Dutch)
Newcastle have reached a verbal agreement with Manchester City to sign Spain midfielder Nico Gonzalez, 24, for £47m plus £3m in add-ons. (Fabrizio Romano)

Manchester United are confident of persuading Arsenal to sell England's Myles Lewis-Skelly, 19, although the asking price of more than £50m remains a sticking point in a deal for the player who can play left-back and midfield. (Sun)
Newcastle have submitted an offer worth 40m euros (£34.2m) excluding bonuses for Lille and Belgium forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo, 21. (L'Equipe - in French)
Chelsea have had three bids rejected this summer for Bournemouth and England midfielder Alex Scott, 23. (The i)
Hull have submitted a 21m euros (£17.9m) offer for Union Berlin and Germany Under-21s forward Ilyas Ansah, with talks over a long-term contract at an advanced stage. (Sky Deutschland - in German)
AC Milan are considering a move late in the transfer window to sign Manchester United and Morocco defender Noussair Mazraoui, 28. (CaughtOffside)
Coventry have agreed a £6m deal to sign Brentford and Jamaica defender Ethan Pinnock, 33. (Athletic - subscription required)
Monza will offer former Tottenham and England midfielder Dele Alli, 30, a one-year contract. He has been without a club since leaving Como in September 2025. (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Manchester City are ready to meet Chelsea 's asking price for Enzo Fernandez, with the Blues wanting £120m for the 25-year-old Argentina midfielder. (Football Insider)
Liverpool and Brighton were expected to hold fresh talks on Sunday over Gambia winger Yankuba Minteh, 22, as the Reds consider whether to make a third bid. (Ben Jacobs via TeamTalk)
Barcelona and Spain left-back Alejandro Balde, 22, has given the green light to his agent Jorge Mendes to negotiate a move to Manchester United . (Sport - in Spanish)
Aston Villa have made contact with Belgian side Club Brugge over the possible signing of 22-year-old Ecaudor centre-back Joel Ordonez. (David Ornstein)
Brentford are preparing to place an improved £37m bid for West Ham United's Senegal defender El Hadji Malick Diouf, 21. (Football Insider)
Manchester United will not sell Netherlands forward Joshua Zirkzee, 25, for less than £40m amid interest from Juventus , Napoli and Aston Villa . (Sun)
Juventus head coach Luciano Spalletti is adamant that Turkey forward Kenan Yildiz, 21, will not be sold to Arsenal . (Metro)
Barcelona are playing down reports linking them with a move for Sporting's Portugal centre-back Goncalo Inacio, 24, with no deal agreed or close. (Fabrizio Romano)
Sporting head coach Rui Borges refused to rule out a move for Inacio to either Barcelona or AC Milan after leaving him out of his starting line-up in their victory over Alverca on Saturday. (Goal)
RB Leipzig have reached a verbal agreement with AC Milan to re-sign France forward Christopher Nkunku, 28, on a season-long loan with an option to buy. (Sky Sports Germany)

Argentina forward Julian Alvarez, 26, is open to joining Arsenal , having previously favoured a switch to Barcelona , with his relationship with current club Atletico Madrid starting to turn "unsavoury". (Standard)

Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta and sporting director Andrea Berta have maintained frequent contact with Alvarez this summer and, while the Argentine still prefers a move to Barcelona, he now views the Gunners as a welcome emergency solution. (AS - in Spanish)
Tottenham are confident they will be able to conclude a deal to sign 27-year-old Egypt forward Omar Marmoush from Manchester City by the start of next week. (Fabrizio Romano)
England striker Ollie Watkins has told Aston Villa he wants to leave the club amid interest from Saudi Pro League side Al-Hilal . (GiveMeSport)
Spain left-back Alejandro Balde, 22, has decided to leave Barcelona , with Manchester United making contact over a possible move. (Metro via Jijantes)
Alternatively, Balde is determined to fight for his place at the Spanish champions. ( Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish )
Real Madrid will not let Liverpool sign Brazil forward Endrick, 20, having already sold Spanish forward Gonzalo Garcia, 22, to Fulham earlier in the transfer window. ( Football Insider )
Chelsea have rejected a loan bid from Roma for England Under-21 forward Jamie Bynoe-Gittens, 22. ( Talksport )
Tottenham have made midfielder Pape Matar Sarr, 23, available for transfer, with the Senegal international set to join Galatasaray . ( Sacha Tavolieri via Teamtalk )
Besiktas have submitted a bid to Newcastle to sign Joe Willock after making the 27-year-old English midfielder their top transfer target. (Fabrizio Romano)

Liverpool have been given a boost in their bid to sign Paris St-Germain's France forward Bradley Barcola, 23, and Senegal attacker Ibrahim Mbaye, 18, after both players were left out of the squad for Sunday's Ligue 1 game against Rennes. (Standard via RMC)
Liverpool have not yet decided whether to send England Under-21s forward Jayden Danns, 20, out on loan following his return to fitness. (Liverpool Echo)

Liverpool have asked Real Madrid about the availability of Brazil forward Endrick, 20, after Brighton rejected a second bid for 22-year-old Gambia winger Yankuba Minteh. (Times - subscription required)
Chelsea expect Aston Villa to submit an offer for their £65m-rated Senegal striker Nicolas Jackson, 25. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Arsenal remain keen on signing Galatasaray striker Victor Osimhen, 27, but only if the Nigeria international lowers his wage demands (Footmercato - in French)
Newcastle and RB Leipzig are in contact with AC Milan over a deal for French forward Christopher Nkunku, 28. (Fabrizio Romano on X)
Atletico Madrid have agreed to sell Argentina striker Julian Alvarez to Arsenal , but the 26-year-old has rejected the move as he only wants to join Barcelona. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Sunderland have reached agreement on an £8m deal to sign DR Congo Under-23s midfielder Jules Ahoka, 20, from Royal Antwerp . (Sky Sports)
Bournemouth are close to signing Juventus goalkeeper Michele di Gregorio, 29, on a loan deal with an option to buy. (Gianluca di Marzio on X)
DR Congo centre-back Willy Kambwala, 21, is on course to join Como from Villarreal, with his previous club Manchester United having a 'sizeable' sell-on clause in any sale. (Mirror)
Crystal Palace and Colombia full-back Daniel Munoz, 30, has been linked with a move to Tottenham , but is having 'second thoughts' about joining Spurs. (Football insider)
Arsenal are exploring a move for Juventus and Turkey winger Kenan Yildiz, 21. (Independent)
Atletico Madrid are trying to finalise the signing of Senegal striker Nicolas Jackson, 25, from Chelsea . (Marca - in Spanish)
Manchester City are in talks to sign Brazilian winger Allan Elias, 22, from Palmeiras . (ESPN)
Manchester City have enquired about the availability of England midfielder Adam Wharton, 22, but their approach has been rebuffed by Crystal Palace . (Sun)
Tottenham are eyeing a move to sign France striker Jean-Philippe Mateta, 29, from Crystal Palace . (Football Insider)
Inter Milan are interested in signing Brazil forward Gabriel Martinelli, 25, from Arsenal . (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
AC Milan are now focused on signing a centre-back and Manchester City 's Portugal defender Ruben Dias, 29, has emerged as a potential target. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Bayer Leverkusen's Burkina Faso centre-back Edmond Tapsoba, 27, has emerged as a leading defensive target for Manchester United , Tottenham and Newcastle . (Teamtalk)
France defender Axel Disasi, 28, is closing in on a loan move from Chelsea to Crystal Palace . (Sun)
Barcelona are yet to make an offer for Argentina striker Lautaro Martinez, 28, but Inter Milan would not be looking to sell regardless. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Barca are also considering Spain forward Ayoze Perez, 33, and Georgia forward Georges Mikautadze, 25, who both play for Villarreal . (Marca - in Spanish)
Liverpool , Everton and Leeds United are among the clubs monitoring Midtjylland's 22-year-old Chile winger Dario Osorio. (Teamtalk)
Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest are thought to be among a number of clubs considering a move for Chelsea 's English striker Liam Delap, 23. (Independent)

Manchester United are concentrating on signing a new left-back, with Racing Santander's 19-year-old Spaniard Jorge Salinas a candidate as Newcastle are not inclined to sell England left-back Lewis Hall, 21. (CaughtOffside)
Manchester City have identified Roma's Manu Kone as a potential signing, with the France midfielder, 25, having already been linked with rivals Manchester United this summer. (Mail)

Aston Villa are interested in signing Chelsea 's English defender Tosin Adarabioyo, 28, as a potential replacement for Ezri Konsa following Arsenal 's deal for the 28-year-old England international. (Sky Sports)
Benfica have also made contact with Chelsea over a potential deal for Adarabioyo. (Sun)
Tottenham are in talks to sign both Brazil winger Savinho, 22, and Egypt forward Omar Marmoush, 27, from Manchester City . (Athletic - subscription required)
Barcelona are monitoring Harry Kane's contract talks with Bayern Munich , with the England striker, 33, having entered the final year of his current deal. (Mail)
Sunderland could shatter their transfer record by triggering the 60m euros (£51m) release clause for Sporting's Mozambique winger Geny Catamo, 25. (Teamtalk)
Everton are interested in Como's Senegal winger Assane Diao, 20, who could cost between £50m and £60m. (Teamtalk)
Arsenal 's Gabriel Jesus is not looking to move to Napoli despite their interest in the Brazil forward, 29. (Mirror)

Juventus have joined Napoli in holding an interest in Manchester United 's Joshua Zirkzee, but both clubs must sell before being able to make a move for the Netherlands forward, 25. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Hull City are close to reaching an agreement with Real Betis for 20-year-old Spanish winger Pablo Garcia. (Sport - in Spanish)
Hull , Ipswich Town and Al-Ittihad are pushing to secure the signing of Morocco midfielder Azzedine Ounahi, 26, from Girona . (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Arsenal are working on deals to sign Gibraltar winger James Scanlon, 19, and English right-back Habeeb Ogunneye, 20, from Manchester United . (Telegraph - subscription required)
Barcelona have put attempts to sign Argentina forward Julian Alvarez, 26, from Atletico Madrid on hold and are exploring other options. (ESPN)
Atletico Madrid are looking to beat Manchester United to the signing of Spanish defender Jorge Salinas, 19, from Racing Santander . (Teamtalk)
Representatives for England captain Harry Kane, 33, have held talks with Saudi Pro League side Al-Hilal , with the Bayern Munich striker open to a move in the future. ( Talksport )
Meanwhile Aston Villa and England striker Ollie Watkins, 29, has agreed personal terms with Al-Hilal , though the Saudi side are yet to submit a transfer offer to Villa. (Teamtalk)
Newcastle have opened exploratory talks with Manchester City over a potential move for Spanish midfielder Nico Gonzalez, 24. (The Athletic - subscription required)
Sunderland 's £25.7m move for Toulouse and France Under-21 defender Dayann Methalie, 20, is in danger of collapsing after concerns were raised over his medical. (Daily Mail)
Coventry have had an offer worth £8.5m for England midfielder Ruben Loftus-Cheek, 30, rejected by AC Milan . (Tuttosport - in Italian)
Real Sociedad have made an approach for West Ham and Mexico midfielder Edson Alvarez, 28, with Ajax having cooled their interest. (Sky Sports)
Ipswich have had a second offer rejected for Bayer Leverkusen and Argentina midfielder Exequiel Palacios, 27. (Florian Plettenberg)
Tottenham are considering a move for Paris St-Germain and Ukraine defender Illia Zabarnyi, 23, after selling Cristian Romero to Atletico Madrid. (Teamtalk)
Liverpool and England midfielder Curtis Jones, 25, remains a top target for Inter Milan , who believe a bid of 35m euros (£29m) will be successful. ( CaughtOffside )
Wolves have entered the race for Brighton winger Amario Cozier-Duberry, 21, with the England under-20 international remaining a target for Rangers and former loan club Bolton . ( The Argus )
Malaga are pursuing English winger Ryan Kent, 29, who has been a free agent since leaving Seattle Sounders in January. ( Fichajes - in Spanish )

Manchester City will have to pay Chelsea more than £120m to land Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez if they try to complete a deal in the final two weeks of the transfer window. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Chelsea want close to £100m if they are to sell Portugal winger Pedro Neto, 26, this summer with Saudi Pro League club Al-Hilal linked with a move. (Mail - subscription required)
Manchester City , Arsenal and Tottenham are all also interested in Neto, who joined Chelsea for £54m from Wolves in 2024. (Metro)
Manchester United have been offered the chance to sign Spain midfielder Marc Casado, 22, who Barcelona have put up for sale. (Sport - in Spanish)

Despite Manchester United 's reluctance to sell, Galatasaray have offered Portugal midfielder Bruno Fernandes £18.3m per season - double his current salary - to tempt him away from Old Trafford. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Liverpool are still keen to sign Paris St-Germain duo Bradley Barcola, 23, and Ibrahim Mbaye, 18, with a combined fee of £155m being mooted for the France winger and Senegal forward. (Teamtalk)
Bayern Munich are confident of agreeing a new deal with England forward Harry Kane, 33, who is entering the final year of his contract. (Bild - in German)
Como have made an offer to take Fiorentina and Italy forward Moise Kean, 26, on loan with an obligation to buy in a package worth £25m. (La Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Leeds have given Suriname striker Joel Piroe, 27, permission to travel to West Ham for a medical. (Sky Sports)
AC Milan have agreed a £34m deal to sign Belgium winger Diego Moreira, 22, from Strasbourg . (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Sao Paulo and West Ham are among the clubs taking an interest in 39-year-old former England forward Jamie Vardy, who is a free agent. (Talksport)
Aston Villa 's Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez, 33, will not be joining Juventus this summer following talks between the clubs. (Athletic - subscription required)
Manchester City are keen to sign Portugal winger Pedro Neto, 26, from Chelsea but face competition from Al-Hilal . (Talksport)
New Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho has approved a move for Arsenal 's Spain midfielder Martin Zubimendi, 27. (Teamtalk)
Nottingham Forest have joined the race to sign Liam Delap from Chelsea , with the 23-year-old English striker keen to stay in the Premier League. (Talksport)
Everton lead the chase for Delap, with Chelsea having already told him that he can leave the club this summer. (Teamtalk)
Newcastle are preparing a bid of 55m euros (£47m) for Villarreal's Georgia forward Georges Mikautadze, 25, who is also interesting Barcelona . (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Nigeria forward Victor Osimhen, 27, has refused to rule out a summer move from Galatasaray , with Arsenal interested. (Caught Offside)
Coventry City are closing in on the signing of Sidiki Cherif from Fenerbahce after agreeing a deal for the Guinea forward, 19. (Give Me Sport)
Everton are keen to sign English midfielder Marcus Tavernier, 27, from Bournemouth before the transfer window shuts. (Football Insider)
A deal for Leeds United 's Suriname forward Joel Piroe, 27, to join West Ham United is in its final stages. (Voetbal International - in Dutch)
Hull City are in advanced talks over a £21m deal for Panathinaikos forward Andreas Tetteh, with Roma also interested in the Greece international. (Ekrem Konur)

Manchester United are stepping up their efforts to cash in on their academy, with English left-back Harry Amass, 19, potentially a player that could move on for about £7m plus add-ons. (Mail - subscription required)
AC Milan manager Ruben Amorim has excluded Youssouf Fofana from his plans for the season, with Nottingham Forest and Crystal Palace now interested in the France midfielder, 27. (Football Insider)
Atletico Madrid want to beat Barcelona to the signing of Morocco midfielder Azzedine Ounahi, 26, who Girona value at about 25m euros (£21.3m). (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Aston Villa are in negotiations to sign Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki from Parma after the 23-year-old's proposed move to Paris St-Germain collapsed. (Talksport)
Villa's interest in Suzuki has boosted Juventus' hope of signing Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez, 33, from the Premier League club. (Football Italia)
Arsenal must offer more than £60m to stand a chance of signing Nigeria striker Victor Osimhen, 27, from Galatasaray this summer. (Football Insider)
Barcelona believe their third offer of 70m euros (£59.8m) for Rodri will be enough to persuade Manchester City to sell the Spain midfielder, 30. (AS - in Spanish)
Manchester City are in negotiations to sign Morocco midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille , who want at least £85m for the 18-year-old. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Newcastle have revived talks to sign Bayern Munich's Joao Palhinha, 31, with Aston Villa and Benfica also interested in the Portugal midfielder. (Mail)

Inter Milan are keen to sell Brazilian winger Luis Henrique, 24, to fund a move for Liverpool 's England midfielder Curtis Jones, 25, who is expected to cost about 40m euros (£34m). (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Chelsea are demanding £60m for Nicolas Jackson, with Aston Villa , Tottenham and Atletico Madrid among the clubs interested in the Senegal striker, 25. (RMC Sport - in French)
Chelsea 's English forward Liam Delap, 23, wants to stay in the Premier League despite interest from Como , with Newcastle and Everton monitoring his situation. (Talksport)
Netherlands forward Cody Gakpo, 27, has made it clear to Liverpool that he wants to leave the club and join Tottenham . (Teamtalk)
Benfica are keen on English defender Tosin Adarabioyo, 28, who has slipped down the pecking order at Chelsea . (Caught Offside)
Arsenal are leading the race to sign English midfielder Jack Hinshelwood, 21, from Brighton . (Sun)
Barcelona are set to make a third bid of about £60m for Spain midfielder Rodri, 30, but are still set to fall £10m short of Manchester City 's valuation. (Independent)
Manchester United , Tottenham and Arsenal have held internal talks about the possibility of signing Nigeria striker Victor Osimhen, 27, from Galatasaray . (Teamtalk)
